prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 对照 · 同一文本的两种角色 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 108px
  col 2: header "年度经营目标" · longest unbreakable word 32px · one-line width 97px
  col 3: header "客户满意度提升" · longest unbreakable word 30px · one-line width 108px
  col 4: header "研发效能改进" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 138px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照三项指标名称及其对应的目标或改进内容，呈现同一文本作为行标题和列标题的两种角色。","reading":"读者先沿首列定位指标，再横向查找对应内容；非空内容集中在对应的列中，短横线表示其余位置无内容。","groups":["第2至第4列都是指标内容列，承担相似的对照角色；它们的标题也分别与首列中的行标题对应。"],"keep_intact":["年度增长 25% 中的 25%","NPS 提升到 50 中的 NPS 和数字 50","各单元格中的数字、百分号和英文缩写"],"may_wrap":["较长的中文列标题和首列指标名称可按自然语义换行。","目标与改进描述可自然换行；同行其他单元格可利用由此产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [89, 85, 87, 98] · table 360×239px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [98, 82, 87, 92] · table 360×262px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [86, 82, 85, 106] · table 360×239px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"四行高度一致，行标题与对应内容容易横向对照；三个内容列的宽度也比较接近。年度增长 25%、NPS 和 50 都保持完整，第四列的描述占两行。","problems":"第二列的目标描述在“增长”后换行，使数值与所描述的增长分离；第四列标题在“改”和“进”之间换行，词组不够完整。首列与各内容列的文字密度也略有差异。","cause":"第二列宽 85px，扣除边距和边框后可用 64px；第四列宽 98px，可用 77px，容不下完整标题。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"首列较宽，行标题比较醒目；NPS 和数字保持完整，前三行高度一致。","problems":"第二列标题和目标描述的断行较零碎；第四列描述增至三行，拉高最后一行，使其他单元格出现较多空白，削弱整表节奏。","cause":"首列增至 98px 后，第二列只有 82px、第四列只有 92px；第四列扣除边距和边框后可用 71px，不足以维持描述的两行排布。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"第四列较宽，研发描述保持两行；四行高度一致，整体紧凑。","problems":"第二列的目标描述断行较零碎；第三列把“提升”拆到两行，影响阅读。第四列增加的宽度没有明显改善行高或标题断行。","cause":"第四列占 106px，挤压了第二、第三列；它们分别只有 82px 和 85px，扣除边距和边框后可用 61px 和 64px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[87,87,87,98],"change":"以 r1A 为基础，将首列的 2px 分给第二列，保留第三、第四列宽度。尝试改善目标描述的断行，同时维持第四列两行描述和相近的内容列比例。"},{"name":"nps-priority","widths":[86,82,93,98],"change":"从 r1C 的第四列转移 8px 给第三列，尝试让 NPS 描述在更自然的位置换行；保留第四列在 r1A 中实现两行描述的宽度。"},{"name":"row-label-priority","widths":[90,85,86,98],"change":"以 r1A 为基础，略增首列宽度并保持第四列宽度，观察行标题的断行与横向定位是否更清楚，同时控制对第三列的挤压。"}]}
